description: Hey hey! I am Daniel and I'm a nerd (or so my wife says). I'm moving soon and trying to look for a job in my new area. I found this a few months ago and called it my "brain marathon" and I've been training for it since. I'm studying cybersecurity and have made many projects on the side. Abstain is my business startup that uses local ai to get things done in creative ways without needing to rely on huge data centers. I hope this project can propel me and my career forward.
